about.title: Meet {name}
about.story1: {name} was born with oxygen deprivation. He spent his first weeks in intensive care, and a few months later we heard the diagnosis that changed our lives.
about.story2: Today he is {age} years old, loves cartoons about a puppy and laughs out loud when his dad tosses him in the air. But daily life means hours of exercises — because every movement has to be earned from scratch.
about.story3: We believe consistent rehabilitation will give him maximum independence. And we are doing everything to make it happen.
about.quote: “{name} is making progress no one predicted at the start. Regular therapy is the key here.”

tax.title: Give 1.5% of your tax
tax.subtitle: It's not an expense — it's part of the tax you pay anyway. You can direct it to {name}.
tax.steps3: How to do it in 3 steps
tax.step1Body: Log in at podatki.gov.pl or in the mObywatel app.
tax.step2Body: In the “1.5% transfer request” section, choose {foundation}.
tax.step3Body: Without it the money reaches the foundation but not {name}.
tax.infoNote: The earmark is not verified by the tax office. If you forget it, your 1.5% goes to the foundation's general budget — so it must appear in the EARMARK field.
tax.received15: What we've received from 1.5% so far

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.subtitle: We don't collect to a private account. Here's exactly where the money goes.
foundation.shieldNote: All donations with the note 433/L go to a dedicated foundation sub-account. Funds are released only against invoices for {name}'s rehabilitation. The parents cannot use them privately.

contact.title: Write to us
contact.subtitle: Questions, media, partnerships — we reply as fast as we can.
contact.abroadBody: You can support {name}'s rehabilitation via the foundation's EUR/USD accounts (see Foundation) with the title “Adam Lipiński 433/L”, or transfer through your bank's BLIK/SEPA. Every receipt is published in Expenses.
